decision_predictions.explanation: CASE-4D5C964234 facts, taken only from spans tied to this register: the bowler's-end signal log records a No-ball call; the ball touched neither the striker's bat nor person; 0 runs were completed before the recorded terminal event; no boundary, appeal or wicket event is recorded for this token. The No-ball call makes the delivery a No-ball (not one of the six valid balls), adds one No-ball extra, and bars Bowled/Caught/LBW/Hit-wicket/Stumped; with no contact, no running and no wicket event there is no dismissal and no batter runs. The bowler is debited with the No-ball extra only. Ledger: NO_BALL_EXTRA 1; total 1 = bowler runs 1. CASE-89C39620E3 points to OBS-8B9D1C52, packet PKT-BDEC1453 logged at 16:48 in over 5. Two signed review entries cover this observation: revision 4 (fielder touched the boundary while carrying the ball before completing control) and revision 7 (no boundary contact occurred before control of ball and movement was complete). Protocol note BBFF51AD directs use of the greatest revision number, so revision 7 is active (active_source HIGHEST_REVISION). Active facts: no No-ball call, ball touched the striker's bat, wicket event submitted was Caught, appeal made in window, control of ball and movement completed with no prior boundary contact, boundary allowance 4 without overthrow. The catch was completed before any boundary contact, so the Caught dismissal would be valid; however the record shows the wicket event did not stand as a dismissal and the agreed 4-run boundary allowance applies to the striker's bat-struck ball. Ledger: BATTER 4; total 4 = bowler runs 4; counts in over. Counterfactual changes only the contact observation to boundary contact before control: under digest 8CA9CCDB a catch is not complete when the fielder touches the boundary while carrying the ball before completing control, so the Caught dismissal fails. The delivery remains legal, no dismissal is recorded, and no boundary allowance can be scored from the failed catch; ledger zero-record, totals 0.
